description.zh: 看圆润粗形与高光位置，再回详情核对具体款式与许可。 可浏览字族样张、输入自定义文本并按字形类别查找的字体资源入口。本次从 Free fonts 栏目进入，但卡片同时包含免费款式与付费字族，不能把栏目名当整包免费；Nexa Round 页展示圆润厚重字形；具体款式、购买和随文件许可须分别核对，本次未提交邮箱或取得字体。
description.en: A font resource entry with family specimens, custom-text preview controls, and type-category browsing. This visit began in Free fonts, whose cards include paid families, so the section name does not establish a free full family. The Nexa Round page presents rounded, heavy letterforms. Styles, purchasing, and bundled licensing require separate checks; no email was submitted and no font file obtained.
